notes.title: An update!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37267404/c02033218d96824fe0ad1f49217e7ea416f49151.png"][/img][/p][p]Holy Macaroni, an update! The game was okie-dokie, but now it's awesome-sauce![/p][p][/p][p]What's new:[/p][p]-Completely new opening, and half new ending[/p][p]-Some [b]annoying action scenes are[/b] improved/[b]simplified[/b][/p][p]-Baby metroid will help you thrice![/p][p]-Alternative way to defeat the 3rd final boss form (just wait for baby metroid)[/p][p]-Some new visual effects here and there[/p][p][/p][p]I hope more will come in the future,[/p][p]Ark[/p]
